A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a simple and efficient model that is competitive with state-of-the-art autoregressive models in terms of quality, but is non-autoregressive and thus can be trained in a few hours.
CARGAN is a simple and effective way to reduce the artifacts of GAN-based mel-spectrogram-to-waveform inversion.
CARGAN is the first model that can produce mel-spectrogram-inverted audio with both fast inference and high quality.
The main takeaway from our work is that

autoregressive modeling is a powerful inductive bias for learning pitch and periodicity in waveform generation, which can be exploited even with non-autoregressive models by autoregressively chunking the waveform.
the inductive bias of autoregression can be used to learn accurate periodicity and pitch even when sampling large chunks of waveform during each forward-pass.

the benefits of autoregressive modeling extend beyond the autoregressive sampling scheme, and that autoregression can be incorporated into non-autoregressive models without sacrificing the advantages of non-autoregression.
